units.source: Hello everyone, I'm the new product manager, Chen Li.
units.translation: Hola a todos, soy la nueva gerente de producto, Chen Li.

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · dialogue line 1
units.source: Welcome aboard, I'm Wang Qiang from marketing.
units.translation: Bienvenida, soy Wang Qiang, del departamento de marketing.

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · dialogue line 2
units.source: Nice to meet you, how long have you been at the company?
units.translation: Mucho gusto, ¿cuánto tiempo llevas en la empresa?

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · dialogue line 3
units.source: Um, I've worked here for three years.
units.translation: Eh, llevo tres años trabajando aquí.

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · dialogue line 4
units.source: Then you must know the company well.
units.translation: Entonces debes conocer bien la empresa.

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · dialogue line 5
units.source: Pretty well, feel free to ask me anytime if you have questions.
units.translation: Bastante bien, no dudes en preguntarme cuando quieras si tienes dudas.

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · dialogue line 6
units.source: Thank you so much, I'm in charge of new product development.
units.translation: Muchas gracias, yo estoy a cargo del desarrollo de nuevos productos.

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · dialogue line 7
Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · dialogue line 8
units.source: It is, but I'm looking forward to it.
units.translation: Lo es, pero tengo muchas ganas de hacerlo.

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · dialogue line 9
units.source: Wish you smooth sailing, come find me anytime you need.
units.translation: Te deseo mucho éxito, ven a buscarme cuando lo necesites.

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · grammar (Subject + 负责 + Noun/Verb Phrase)
units.source: "负责" states an area of responsibility - "我负责新产品的开发" means "I'm in charge of new product development".
units.translation: "负责" indica un área de responsabilidad: "我负责新产品的开发" significa "estoy a cargo del desarrollo de nuevos productos".

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Introducing Yourself Professionally · grammar (Subject + 负责 + Noun/Verb Phrase)
units.source: Confusing 负责 (in charge of, a formal role) with 做 (to do, more generic) - 负责 fits describing a defined responsibility.
units.translation: Confundir 负责 (estar a cargo de, un rol formal) con 做 (hacer, más genérico); 负责 es apropiado para describir una responsabilidad definida.

units.source: Present a contrast within one idea

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Workplace Small Talk · grammar (虽然 + A + 但是 + B)
units.source: "虽然...但是..." links a concession (A) with a contrasting point (B) - "虽然忙，但是可以接受" means "although busy, it's manageable".
units.translation: "虽然...但是..." conecta una concesión (A) con un punto contrastante (B): "虽然忙，但是可以接受" significa "aunque ocupado, es manejable".

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Workplace Small Talk · grammar (虽然 + A + 但是 + B)
units.source: Using only 但是 without 虽然 at the start - both together make the contrast explicit and balanced.
units.translation: Usar solo 但是 sin 虽然 al inicio; usados juntos hacen el contraste explícito y equilibrado.

units.context: Scenario: Work & Office · Lesson: Workplace Small Talk · grammar example (虽然 + A + 但是 + B)
